## Czlonka 2021 bleached Curaua / rigid polyurethane foam composites

Selected factual records are transcribed and curated from Sylwia Członka,
Eduardo Fischer Kerche, Roberta Motta Neves, Anna Strąkowska and Krzysztof
Strzelec, *Bio-Based Rigid Polyurethane Foam Composites Reinforced with Bleached
Curauá Fiber*, International Journal of Molecular Sciences 22(20), 11203 (2021),
[DOI: 10.3390/ijms222011203](https://doi.org/10.3390/ijms222011203).
Copyright 2021 by the authors; licensee MDPI, Basel, Switzerland. The article
is licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Xiao Hu and Antonella Piozzi are academic editors, not authors.

Changes are transcription of three Table 2 apparent-density means and their
nominal bleached Curaua loadings relative to total RPUF mass, source-scoped
foam states, literal coefficient-of-variance superscripts and statistical-group
letters. Unknown CV units are not inferred as percent or SD. Null typed
uncertainty does not mean the source reports no variation. Ten density samples
per group are preserved; independent production batches, repeat readings and
measurement age are unknown. The 24 h preparation cure and at least 7 day
post-cure discussion remain separate, unresolved statements. Neither is assigned
as density test age. Neat RPUF and other properties are excluded.

The producer inspected the publisher PDF (3836264 bytes, SHA-256
`321d2018f69229320a9a3bfc45686b69a486ff799e1c1414341271ac965f5d17`)
and official Europe PMC XML (138976 bytes, SHA-256
`571bca76ff07f59a4b258697855e00284cc3cb034ef6747709f8f9a9a5c8c0c3`).
Independent source review reproduced the XML bytes; publisher PDF access
returned 403, so PDF hash and visual checks remain producer evidence. Neither
archive version nor archive PDF manifest is claimed. No separate restriction
was observed for selected Table 2 and methods. Only attributed selected facts
and original curation are distributed, without PDF, XML full text, screenshots
or raw data. No endorsement, scientific replication, independent scientific
review or engineering allowable is implied.
